sheets.title: ROOF PLAN / DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Existing building roof plan showing single-story CMU structure with modified bitumen roofing over steel deck and rigid insulation (R=11). Four scuppers with downspouts on longitudinal sides. Roof-mounted mechanical equipment (exhaust fan noted). Details show door head, jamb, threshold, casework/equipment mounting, typical full-height wall, and downspout/scupper details. Title block references 'Radar Operation and Range Tracking, Patuxent Naval Air Station, Project C12-444' — original building use before SCIF conversion. Sheet number A-2 of what appears to be a set of at least 3 (reference to A-3).

sheets.title: ROOF PLAN / DETAILS (Elevations and Sections)
sheets.reading_notes: Four exterior elevations (West, North, East, South) showing single-story CMU/brick veneer building. West elevation shows main entry with aluminum frame windows. Brick face with soldier course at parapet. Metal flashing at expansion joints and top of masonry. Two sections (longitudinal and transverse) show interior layout: open office, MR lab, POP room. Suspended acoustic tile ceiling with metal stud framing to roof deck. 8' CMU walls with 4' brick face. Depressed slab at entry. Building appears roughly rectangular. Wall section detail shows 8" CMU, R-14 batt insulation in metal stud framing, ½" gyp bd. Parapet with 24 GA aluminum reglet. Steel deck with modified bitumen roof (R=11). Note: original spaces ('open office', 'MR lab', 'POP room') correspond to functions that the SCIF renovation will reconfigure.

sheets.title: FOUNDATION PLAN / ROOF FRAMING PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Foundation plan shows 80'-0" × 48'-0" overall building footprint. Concrete slab on grade with 6" C.I.P. slab over base course. Typical masonry wall reinforcing at 36" O.C. vertically. Typical door and window cell reinforcing noted. Step footings at depressed slab entry. Roof framing plan shows 28" K-series open web steel joists at regular spacing (appears to be 5 equal spaces on the long dimension and 3 equal spaces on the short dimension per reference lines). Joist legend: 28 IN., 1K series, Total Load 2K PLF, Snow Load 80 PLF, Net Uplift -21 PLF. Design loads: Roof LL 25 PSF, Dead Load 15 PSF, Wind Zone I. Soils investigation by Bob Taylor Engineering, Lexington Park MD; finished grade 2'-6" below finish grade; soil profile SE (assumed).

sheets.title: FOUNDATION / STRUCTURAL DETAILS
sheets.reading_notes: Foundation and structural details. Typical foundation at depressed slab, slab step, foundation at depressed slab (door opening), typical lintel, typical foundation wall section. Structural steel details: joist bearing, ledger angle, roof opening frame, metal deck to joist. General notes confirm CMU 8" block, hollow concrete units ASTM C90, mortar type S, grout 2000 psi. All concrete cast-in-place min 3000 psi (28 days). Open web steel joists per SJI specifications. Metal roof deck #20 gauge per Steel Deck Institute, SDI-DI 3.235 N. 3.

gross_square_footage.notes: Computed from plan dimensions 80'-0" × 48'-0". BOD states 'approximately 3900 SF'; fire protection table states '~3,850'. Minor discrepancy; 3,840 SF is the most precise measurement from drawings.

conflict_flags.resolution_chosen: BOD Architectural section (3,900 SF for text representation; 3,840 SF used as drawing-derived value in drawings.facts_derived block)
conflict_flags.rationale: All three values are consistent to within ~1.6%. BOD rounds to 3,900 SF as an approximate; fire protection code analysis rounds to ~3,850; drawings yield the precise 3,840 SF footprint. For the facts.square_footage field, 3,900 SF is chosen per the BOD's expressed scope statement. Drawings block uses 3,840 SF as the most precise measurement. This is a minor discrepancy explained by rounding.

Only one source provides a cost figure; it is an estimate range from the solicitation, not an awarded contract value. No conflict — single source only. Flagged to note that the actual awarded contract value is not in available documents.
